svg.text: Clarity: as-built wiring (sensors, tipping cup, ESP-NOW radio)
Every +5V symbol goes to the breadboard red (+) rail, every ground symbol to the blue (−) rail. Crossing wires without a dot are NOT connected.
LDR on the cup wall + 10 kΩ
shows readings and the filter choice
Wired to A4 (SDA) and A5 (SCL), the same pins
powers the Uno, sensors and servo
tips the test cup left or right
passes it to the Pi over USB
ESP-NOW link, no Wi‑Fi or cell
→ 10 kΩ → ESP32 RX2; 2× 10 kΩ to GND
rails; 1000 µF across the servo supply
